g.text: Haydovchilar imtihoni uchun premium test platforma
Logo, web dashboard, quiz interface, mobile mockup, tokenlar va komponentlar.
Shield + road marker + safety signal. Premium, simple, app-icon friendly.
Calm premium palette, high contrast, soft surfaces.
Inter UI / 700: buttons, tabs, active states
Inter Body / 500: explanations, helper copy, descriptions
Reusable pieces for production UI and Figma handoff.
Testlar, biletlar, mavzulashtirilgan mashqlar va xato savollar bitta joyda.
Belgilar, chorraha, tezlik va qoida mavzulari.
YHQ 1-ilovasi 3.27: izoh savol tanlangandan keyin shu joyda darhol chiqadi.
379 ta belgi, rasm, guruh va vazifasi bilan.
Bu board Figma'ga import qilinadi va keyin frame/layerlar bo'yicha alohida tartiblanadi.
01 Logo: shield + road marker, app icon va wordmark.
02 Colors: calm teal, mint success, blue action, red error, soft white surfaces.
03 Quiz: immediate feedback, green correct, red wrong, explanation under question.
04 Navigation: sticky Oldingi / Keyingi controls for desktop and mobile.
05 Catalog: signs grid with search, group chips, sign task/description.
06 Components: buttons, answer states, feedback panel, ticket row, mobile frame.
